ValidationRule.description: If Status is updated to Complete then Actual Attendance field should not be null
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.ProjectTaskValidations__c), ISPICKVAL( pse__Status__c , 'Complete') , RecordType.Name = 'PEO Project Task', NSP_Category__c = 'Client Implementation', NSP_Sub_Category__c = 'New Client - EE OT Meeting', ISBLANK( NSP_Actual_Attendance__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Actual Attendance must be entered before setting the task status to Complete
